name: Nishaktata Pension Yojana (JBOCWWB)
nodalDept: Labour, Employment, Training and Skill Department
briefDescription: "Nishaktata Pension Yojana (JBOCWWB)" is a scheme by the Department of Labour, Employment, Training & Skill Development Govt of Jharkhand. The scheme provides a pension of ₹ 1,000/- per month to the registered beneficiary who is permanently disabled due to paralysis/leprosy/tuberculosis/accident.
descriptionMd: "Nishaktata Pension Yojana (JBOCWWB)" is a scheme by the Department of Labour, Employment, Training & Skill Development Govt of Jharkhand. This is a 100% State Sponsored Scheme. Only the residents/domicile of the state of Jharkhand can apply to this scheme. Applications for this scheme are accepted online through the official website of the department. The scheme provides a pension of ₹ 1,000/- per month to the registered beneficiary who is permanently disabled due to paralysis/leprosy/tuberculosis/accident.
eligibilityMd:
1. The applicant should be a domicile in the state of Jharkhand.
1. The applicant should be between 18-60 years of age.
1. The applicant should be a Registered Worker with the 'Jharkhand Building and Other Construction Worker Welfare Board (JBOCWW Board)'.
1. The applicant should be permanently disabled due to paralysis/leprosy/tuberculosis/accidents.
